build_acp_agent_config: build an ACPAgentConfig instance with command, description, and optional model for an ACP-compatible agent
load_acp_config_from_dict: load ACP agent configurations from a dictionary mapping agent names to config fields
get_acp_agents: get the currently configured ACP agents as a mapping of agent name to ACPAgentConfig
test_acp_agent_config: test creating an ACPAgentConfig with command, args, env, description, and auto_approve_permissions fields
review_acp_config_load: review the load_acp_config_from_dict function to validate it loads agent configs from a dictionary safely
